DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: equipment jam
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A set of production equipment has stopped due to wear.

li.label: Replace the parts
li.description: Use three components and restore operation immediately.

li.label: Make a temporary repair
li.description: Have a skilled builder patch the equipment, reducing its output for five days.

li.label: Shut down for maintenance
li.description: Disable a random production facility for three days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: exceptional materials
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Workers have found the latest batch of raw materials to be unusually fine.

li.label: Increase output
li.description: Double the next output of a random production facility.

li.label: Reserve for fine processing
li.description: Set the materials aside for a valuable finished batch.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: sell a batch of valuable products
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The exceptional materials are being worked into a valuable batch for sale.

li.label: Process and sell
li.description: Complete the batch and receive 1,000 silver.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: work accident
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: An accident has occurred at the busy worksite.

li.label: Conduct a full shutdown inspection
li.description: Halve production for three days.

li.label: Improve safety procedures
li.description: Reduce production for three days, then increase it for eight days.

li.label: Overhaul safety procedures
li.description: Use 100 steel; halve production for three days, then increase it for ten days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: tool shortage
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Many tools can no longer be used.

li.label: Replace the tools
li.description: Use 50 steel to replenish the tools.

li.label: Repair them locally
li.description: Have a skilled crafter repair the tools. Everyone gains Crafting experience, but production is slightly reduced for five days.

li.label: Make do
li.description: Continue with inadequate tools, reducing production for five days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: scrap buildup
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Production waste is taking up more and more workspace.

li.label: Recycle it
li.description: Have a skilled crafter recover 80 steel.

li.label: Dump it in the wasteland
li.description: Reduce industrial tendency and increase frontier tendency for eight days.

li.label: Store it temporarily
li.description: Accept reduced production for five days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: process improvement
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A worker has proposed a way to improve the production process.

li.label: Trial the proposal
li.description: Increase a random production facility's output for ten days.

li.label: Reward the proposer
li.description: Pay 300 silver and improve the effect.

li.label: Keep the old process
li.description: Make no changes.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: prototype test
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Workers have assembled an untested piece of equipment.

li.label: Put it into production
li.description: Increase a random facility's output for six days.

li.label: Dismantle it for research
li.description: Gain 200 research points and give every colonist Crafting experience.

li.label: Break it down for parts
li.description: Recover two to four components.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: herd tracks
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Tracks left by a migration of large wild animals have been found nearby.

li.label: Organize a hunt
li.description: Track down the herd and butcher the catch.

li.label: Keep your distance
li.description: Leave the herd alone.

li.label: Guide the herd away from the roads
li.description: Divert workers to guide the animals away from local routes.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: road washed out by heavy rain
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Rainwater has washed out the dirt road connecting the outpost.

li.label: Repair it immediately
li.description: Commit most of the workforce to reopen the road at once.

li.label: Wait for the road to recover naturally
li.description: Avoid spending resources, but accept slower travel for a time.

li.label: Build drainage ditches
li.description: Rebuild the road with drainage intended to prevent another washout.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: abandoned camp
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A scout has found a small camp abandoned in haste.

li.label: Search for supplies
li.description: Search the camp for anything useful.

li.label: Investigate carefully
li.description: Have an experienced thinker reconstruct what happened and search methodically.

li.label: Do not approach
li.description: Leave the camp untouched.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: lost traveler
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: An exhausted traveler has arrived at the outpost asking for help.

li.label: Provide supplies and directions
li.description: Divert some output to provision the traveler and show them a safe route onward.

li.label: Invite them to stay
li.description: Offer the traveler a place among the outpost's colonists.

li.label: Refuse them
li.description: Send the traveler away.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: contaminated water source
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The water source near the outpost has developed an unusual smell.

li.label: Boil the stored water
li.description: Boil and ration the existing water, reducing core output for two days.

li.label: Find a new water source
li.description: Survey the surroundings for clean water.

li.label: Continue using it
li.description: Keep using the contaminated source and accept reduced core facility output.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: hidden cave
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A collapsed hillside has exposed a previously unknown cave entrance.

li.label: Mine the exposed vein
li.description: Have an experienced miner exploit the deposit.

li.label: Seal the entrance
li.description: Avoid the risk and close the cave.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: extreme cold snap or heat wave
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Extreme weather is approaching the poorly sheltered outpost.

li.label: Reinforce the shelters
li.description: Use 100 steel and 50 wood to protect the outpost while construction briefly slows work.

li.label: Suspend operations
li.description: Keep everyone safe by halting most work for three days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: wilderness distress signal
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The radio has picked up a broken distress call.

li.label: Rescue them immediately
li.description: Send a defended rescue team and bring back a survivor and supplies.

li.label: Tell them to come to the outpost
li.description: Give directions and wait three to five days for an answer.

li.label: Assume it is a trap
li.description: Ignore the signal.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: signal lost
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The distress transmission faded and never returned. Whoever sent it did not reach the outpost.

li.label: Acknowledge
li.description: There is nothing more to be done.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: misdirected cargo
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A shipment belonging to someone else has arrived in the outpost warehouse.

li.label: Return it
li.description: Return the cargo and gain goodwill.

li.label: Keep it
li.description: Keep goods worth 1,000, but lose goodwill.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: temporary market
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Several traveling groups want to exchange goods beside the outpost.

li.label: Open the market
li.description: Offer up to 5,000 market value from storage and receive random goods worth 1.5 times as much.

li.label: Charge stall fees
li.description: Gain 500 silver and improve population tendency.

li.label: Refuse them
li.description: Do not host the market.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: bulk order
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A nearby merchant wants to purchase a large quantity of goods.

li.label: Accept the order
li.description: Generate a standard trade request quest.

li.label: Demand an advance
li.description: Use a skilled negotiator to receive 500 silver before accepting the order.

li.label: Refuse
li.description: Decline the order.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: new resident application
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A traveler wants to settle permanently at the outpost.

li.label: Accept
li.description: Gain an excellent colonist while integration slows production for three days.

li.label: Refuse
li.description: Turn the applicant away.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: security problem
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The warehouse shows signs of theft and vandalism. About 20% of ordinary stored goods have disappeared.

li.label: Organize patrols
li.description: Use the outpost's defenses to recover the stolen goods.

li.label: Investigate publicly
li.description: Have a skilled speaker expose the thieves and recover the goods.

li.label: Accept the loss
li.description: Do not pursue the missing goods.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: group migration
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A small group of homeless people asks to settle together at the outpost.

li.label: Accept everyone
li.description: Gain three common colonists; production falls for five days.

li.label: Accept only a skilled applicant
li.description: Gain one excellent colonist; production falls slightly for three days.

li.label: Provision them and send them on
li.description: Lose one day of output and gain 30 goodwill.

li.label: Refuse
li.description: Turn the group away.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: unexpected observation
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Researchers have noticed an unusual pattern in routine records.

li.label: Analyze it deeply
li.description: Gain 2,000 research points while research output is slightly reduced for two days.

li.label: Apply it immediately
li.description: Increase a random production facility's output for eight days.

li.label: Archive it
li.description: Gain 1,000 research points.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: instrument calibration
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Long-term measurement errors can no longer be ignored.

li.label: Calibrate precisely
li.description: Use an experienced researcher to improve research output for ten days.

li.label: Replace components
li.description: Use two components for the same improvement.

li.label: Correct the data temporarily
li.description: Research output falls for five days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: field sample
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Workers have returned with locally collected samples of scientific interest.

li.label: Analyze thoroughly
li.description: Have an expert researcher gain 2,000 research points.

li.label: Preserve the sample
li.description: Wait for a random follow-up result.

li.label: Treat it as ordinary material
li.description: Gain random resources worth 500.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: exceptional sample
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Further study shows that the preserved sample is exceptionally valuable.

li.label: Exploit the discovery
li.description: Generate a random useful techprint.

li.label: Sell the sample
li.description: Sell it for 4,000 silver.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: ordinary sample
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The preserved sample proves to have no unusual properties.

li.label: Record the result
li.description: Gain 500 research points.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: sample preservation failure
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The sample was spoiled during storage.

li.label: Accept it
li.description: Nothing can be recovered.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: laboratory accident
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: An error has caused a flash fire and hazardous leak.

li.label: Respond immediately
li.description: Use medical expertise; research output falls for two days.

li.label: Seal the laboratory
li.description: Disable a random research facility for four days.

li.label: Recover the data
li.description: Use medical and intellectual experts; disable a research facility for three days and gain 1,000 research points.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: theoretical breakthrough
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Researchers have proposed a theory that may greatly advance the current project.

li.label: Concentrate on verification
li.description: Increase research output for six days while other production falls.

li.label: Verify steadily
li.description: Increase research output for ten days.

li.label: Keep the original plan
li.description: Gain 500 research points.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: sealed engineering archive
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Workers clearing old equipment have found a sealed set of engineering records. The plans describe an unfamiliar production device, but key parameters are damaged.

li.label: Reconstruct the design
li.description: Assign skilled workers to restore the plans, reducing production for two days.

li.label: Dismantle the archived samples
li.description: Recover three components and extract useful research notes.

li.label: Seal it again
li.description: Leave the archive undisturbed.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: efficient transmission system
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The restored plans reveal an elegant transmission system. It should be straightforward to build, but its use must be decided.

li.label: Install it fully
li.description: Increase a random production facility's output by 40% for eight days.

li.label: Run a conservative test
li.description: Increase a random production facility's output by 20% for ten days and train the workers.

li.label: Compile research notes
li.description: Gain 1,000 research points.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: dangerous design flaw
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Testing shows that the device can raise output, but its critical components overheat rapidly.

li.label: Install heat-resistant parts
li.description: Use 80 steel and two components to improve a random production facility for eight days.

li.label: Run it at reduced power
li.description: Increase a random production facility's output by 15% for ten days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: cache coordinates
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A concealed page records the coordinates of an old industrial cache. The record is dated, but the location remains clear.

li.label: Organize a recovery team
li.description: Secure the cache and recover industrial supplies.

li.label: Dismantle the dangerous structure carefully
li.description: Commit skilled builders for two days and recover more industrial material.

li.label: It is not worth the risk
li.description: Leave the cache alone.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: unrecoverable draft
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Too much of the archive is missing. The supposed device may never have existed outside the drawings.

li.label: Document the failed reconstruction
li.description: Gain 500 research points.

li.label: Stop here
li.description: Abandon the reconstruction.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: letter from afar
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: An outpost resident has received a letter passed from traveler to traveler. Their relatives and several companions are seeking a new home nearby.

li.label: Invite them to come
li.description: Encourage settlement and wait one to three days for one of four possible outcomes.

li.label: Send an escort
li.description: Divert workers for one day and wait for an outcome that excludes the possibility of the group becoming lost.

li.label: Decline politely
li.description: Do not invite the group.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: safe arrival
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The people mentioned in the letter have reached the outpost safely. They are exhausted, but ready to make a permanent home.

li.label: Accept everyone
li.description: Gain two common colonists while production falls for four days.

li.label: Select a skilled settler
li.description: Gain one excellent colonist while production falls slightly for three days.

li.label: Offer temporary shelter
li.description: Increase population tendency for fifteen days.

li.label: Ask them to continue onward
li.description: Send the travelers on their way.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: skills brought from afar
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Several visitors are experienced craftspeople. They are willing to exchange their labor for the outpost's help.

li.label: Keep the finest craftsperson
li.description: Gain one excellent colonist.

li.label: Ask them to train the residents
li.description: All colonists gain Crafting and Construction experience, and population tendency improves.

li.label: Commission a batch of products
li.description: Double the next output of a random production facility.

li.label: Provision them and say farewell
li.description: Slightly reduce production for one day and improve population tendency.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: dispute among the travelers
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The arrivals disagree bitterly over whether to remain, and ask the outpost's leaders to settle the matter.

li.label: Mediate publicly
li.description: Use a skilled speaker to settle the dispute, gain one common colonist, and improve population tendency.

li.label: House them separately
li.description: Gain two common colonists while production falls for four days.

li.label: Do not intervene
li.description: Population tendency falls for ten days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: lost on the road
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The appointed day has passed, but the travelers never appeared. Their last message suggests they lost their way in the wilderness.

li.label: Send a search party
li.description: Use the outpost's defenses to rescue one traveler and recover supplies.

li.label: Keep broadcasting directions
li.description: Slightly reduce production for one day, then learn whether anyone found the signal.

li.label: End the search
li.description: Do nothing further.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: signal-guided survivor
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: One of the missing travelers followed the signal and reached the outpost.

li.label: Welcome them
li.description: Gain one common colonist.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: no answer to the signal
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The directions were broadcast repeatedly, but none of the missing travelers arrived.

li.label: Acknowledge
li.description: There is nothing more to be done.
